newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Backus says open to new partners.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Backus says open to new partners.

text.p: Peru's top brewer, the UCP Backus group, said Friday it was open to the possibility of a foreign firm taking a stake in the company after receiving visits from interested brewery companies.

"There is a world trend towards partnerships and we cannot be closed to this possibility. Some international brewers have spoken to us, have visited Peru and done studies, but there is nothing concrete," Backus said in a statement sent to Reuters.

Last year, Chilean brewer Compania Cervecerias Unidas (CCU) was considering forming a partnership with Backus and Argentina's Quilmes Industrial SA had earlier shown an interest in buying part of the company.
Backus's statement also said the company's production capacity exceeded demand and the firm currently operated at 55 percent of installed capacity.

At the beginning of the year, the Backus group formed UCP Backus by merging its sister companies Backus y Johnston, Compania Nacional de Cerveza, Sociedad Cervecera de Trujillo and Cerveceria del Norte.
The new company, whose full name is Union de Cervecerias Peruanas Backus y Johnston SA, reported earlier Friday a net profit for the first half of the year of 46.9 milllion soles.
